units.source_text: 只要对某个长住客人产生了好感，她们就把这客人餐盘里的剩菜，拿到自己的餐盘里吃。

en.t: Whenever they took a liking to some long-term guest, they would take the leftovers from that guest's plate onto their own plates and eat them.

units.source_text: 不过，这只限于“男客”的餐盘。

en.t: However, this applied only to the plates of male guests.

units.source_text: 也许是出于本能吧，女客餐盘里的东西，

en.t: Perhaps out of instinct, as for the food on female guests' plates,
they would not even glance at it.
